question: Five solid cubes, each of volume 216000 cm³ , are joined end to end to form a cuboid. What is the lateral surface area (in cm² ) of the cuboid?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Side of each cube, a = ³√216000 = 60 cm.

When 'n' cubes are joined end-to-end, the Lateral Surface Area (LSA) of the resulting cuboid = 2a²(n + 1).

Here, number of cubes (n) = 5 and side (a) = 60 cm.

LSA = 2 × 60² × (5 + 1) = 2 × 3600 × 6 = 43200 cm².

**∴ The correct answer is 43200 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 Cuboid Formed by 5 Cubes

**Calculations:**

⇒ a³ = 216000

⇒ a = 60 cm

⇒ Length of the resulting cuboid (L) = 5 × a = 5 × 60 = 300 cm

⇒ Breadth of the cuboid (B) = a = 60 cm

⇒ Height of the cuboid (H) = a = 60 cm

⇒ LSA = 2 × H × (L + B)

⇒ LSA = 2 × 60 × (300 + 60)

⇒ LSA = 120 × 360 = 43200 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 43200 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Properties of Joined Cubes

When 'n' cubes of edge 'a' are joined end to end, the resulting cuboid has Length = na, Breadth = a, and Height = a.

Lateral Surface Area (LSA) of a Cuboid

The LSA represents the area of the 4 vertical faces excluding the top and bottom faces. Formula: LSA = 2H(L + B).

Total Surface Area (TSA) of a Cuboid

The TSA includes the area of all 6 faces of the cuboid. Formula: TSA = 2(LB + BH + HL).
